events.title: Demo update 0.9.27 is live: menu fixes and better diagnostics
events.summary: Thanks to everyone trying the Haul Yeah! demo and sharing feedback. Some of you reported a laggy main menu or trouble getting into the game. Demo update 0.9.27 is now live for Windows, macOS and Linux, including Steam Deck. What changed Reworked startup preparation so the main menu opens over the moving world, rather than a frozen background. Improved loading and save-menu handling to keep menu interactions responsive. events.title: The Haul Yeah! demo is out, let's get hauling!
events.summary: The Haul Yeah! demo is now available! Watch: Haul Yeah! demo on Steam Deck Stack your cargo, tighten those straps and head out on your first deliveries. We hope you have a great time exploring the county, and finding out just how much you can squeeze onto your truck. Play on your PC, or take it on the roadThe demo supports Windows, macOS and Linux. Got a Steam Deck? It’s been running beautifully in our testing, and we’d love to hear how it plays for you too. Let us know how your deliveries goAs
